gorselStil: Dark cinematic hand-drawn graphic-novel illustration, Hollywood survival-thriller mood: bold black ink outlines, fine cross-hatching, painterly shading, deep cold blue-teal ocean shadows with harsh red accents (storm lightning, emergency flare, sunset).
